positions.name: FerryLateSailingsFollowRidership
positions.frame: Given how many passengers each late sailing actually carries, which late sailings should the ferry timetable keep, move, or leave alone?
positions.why: Both statements read the late ferry timetable against observed ridership. Tamsin cites under ten passengers a night to move the weekday last sailing from 22:40 to 21:55 from November. Rolf cites Friday and Saturday late sailings still filling to leave the weekend timetable unchanged. The two sit together as complementary cases under one demand-based frame, not as a conflict. No existing position or narrative covers ferry operations, so no `under` is proposed.
